issues: Cream screenshot cards on a cream paper backdrop blended together, so the group photo had no depth or separation
Every element sat at the same depth and brightness, and the white cards kept competing with the wordmark after it landed
The launch atmosphere was one light sweep at 0.12 opacity plus 20 gold motes, nowhere near the film's energy peak
The last 12f faded the whole frame to warm ink, leaving a greyed-out final frame
changes: Midnight look: a deep blue stage with three slowly swaying overhead light beams, a horizon glow and a feathered, dimmed LED-wall backdrop; the real white screenshot cards glow against the dark stage, so the group photo reads instantly

Three depth layers: small, soft, dim nav and paper strips at the back, search, weekly report and field cards in the middle, and three large crisp project cards up front with the heaviest contact shadows; the nine elements fly in from every side along outward vectors, with tightening cues, spin, directional motion blur, overshoot and a landing squash

Wordmark finale rebuilt: an INTRODUCING kicker, a 150px wordmark rising letter by letter, an electric-blue rule with extension lines, then the subline 'One console for every experiment.'; everything else steps back 22% darker and the stage light behind fires once
A bigger crane (rotateX 9°, 46px drop, scale 1.1→1) followed by a zero-velocity 3% push; cool white dust drifts upward throughout
145→150f, the end fade is gone, the wordmark holds 2s+ and the final frame is a complete launch poster
